        if check and r.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{shlex.join([str(x) for x in cmd])}: {r.returncode}: {r.stderr}')
        return r
    def git(self, *args, data=None):
        return self.run(['git', '-C', self.repo, *args], data=data).stdout.strip()
    def write(self, rel, data):
        p = self.repo / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(data)
        return p
    def external(self, rel, data):
        p = self.base / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(data)
        return p
    def commit(self, remote=False, detached=False):
        self.git('add', '-A')
        tree = self.git('write-tree')
        cmd = ['commit-tree', tree]
        if hasattr(self, 'head'):
            cmd += ['-p', self.head]
        sha = self.git(*cmd, data='S10 fixture tree\n')
        if detached:
            self.git('update-ref', '--no-deref', 'HEAD', sha)
        else:
            self.git('update-ref', 'refs/heads/main', sha)
        self.head = sha
        if remote:
            self.pushed(sha)
        return sha

        self.git('update-ref', 'refs/remotes/origin/main', sha)
        self.git('symbolic-ref', 'refs/remotes/origin/HEAD', 'refs/remotes/origin/main')

            'cd -- "$1" && find . -path ./\\.git -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum | sha256sum',
